using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class MigrateSessionTests
    {
        private class TestMigrateSession : MigrateSession
        {
            public TestMigrateSession(ILogger logger) : base()
            {
                this.logger = logger;
            }

            public ILogger Logger => logger;

            // Expose protected/private members for testing if needed
            public async Task CallBeginAsyncMigrationTaskAsync()
            {
                await BeginAsyncMigrationTaskAsync();
            }

            // Override dependencies and methods to simulate failure scenarios
            public Func<string, MigrateState, Task<bool>> TrySetSlotRangesAsyncOverride { get; set; }
            public Func<Task<bool>> ReserveDestinationVectorSetsAsyncOverride { get; set; }
            public Func<Task<bool>> MigrateSlotsDriverInlineAsyncOverride { get; set; }
            public Func<bool> TryPrepareLocalForMigrationOverride { get; set; }
            public Func<Task> TryRecoverFromFailureAsyncOverride { get; set; }
            public Func<Task<bool>> BumpAndWaitForEpochTransitionAsyncOverride { get; set; }

            protected override Task<bool> TrySetSlotRangesAsync(string nodeid, MigrateState state)
            {
                if (TrySetSlotRangesAsyncOverride != null)
                    return TrySetSlotRangesAsyncOverride(nodeid, state);
                return base.TrySetSlotRangesAsync(nodeid, state);
            }

            protected override Task<bool> ReserveDestinationVectorSetsAsync()
            {
                if (ReserveDestinationVectorSetsAsyncOverride != null)
                    return ReserveDestinationVectorSetsAsyncOverride();
                return base.ReserveDestinationVectorSetsAsync();
            }

            protected override Task<bool> MigrateSlotsDriverInlineAsync()
            {
                if (MigrateSlotsDriverInlineAsyncOverride != null)
                    return MigrateSlotsDriverInlineAsyncOverride();
                return base.MigrateSlotsDriverInlineAsync();
            }

            protected override bool TryPrepareLocalForMigration()
            {
                if (TryPrepareLocalForMigrationOverride != null)
                    return TryPrepareLocalForMigrationOverride();
                return base.TryPrepareLocalForMigration();
            }

            protected override Task TryRecoverFromFailureAsync()
            {
                if (TryRecoverFromFailureAsyncOverride != null)
                    return TryRecoverFromFailureAsyncOverride();
                return base.TryRecoverFromFailureAsync();
            }

            protected override Task<bool> BumpAndWaitForEpochTransitionAsync()
            {
                if (BumpAndWaitForEpochTransitionAsyncOverride != null)
                    return BumpAndWaitForEpochTransitionAsyncOverride();
                return base.BumpAndWaitForEpochTransitionAsync();
            }
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task BeginAsyncMigrationTaskAsync_LogsError_WhenTrySetSlotRangesAsyncFails()
        {
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var migrateSession = new TestMigrateSession(loggerMock.Object);

            migrateSession.TrySetSlotRangesAsyncOverride = (nodeid, state) => Task.FromResult(false);
            migrateSession.TryRecoverFromFailureAsyncOverride = () => Task.CompletedTask;

            await migrateSession.CallBeginAsyncMigrationTaskAsync();

            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Failed to set remote slots")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task BeginAsyncMigrationTaskAsync_LogsError_WhenTryPrepareLocalForMigrationFails()
        {
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var migrateSession = new TestMigrateSession(loggerMock.Object);

            migrateSession.TrySetSlotRangesAsyncOverride = (nodeid, state) => Task.FromResult(true);
            migrateSession.TryPrepareLocalForMigrationOverride = () => false;
            migrateSession.TryRecoverFromFailureAsyncOverride = () => Task.CompletedTask;

            await migrateSession.CallBeginAsyncMigrationTaskAsync();

            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Failed to set local slots")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task BeginAsyncMigrationTaskAsync_LogsError_WhenReserveDestinationVectorSetsFails()
        {
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var migrateSession = new TestMigrateSession(loggerMock.Object);

            migrateSession.TrySetSlotRangesAsyncOverride = (nodeid, state) => Task.FromResult(true);
            migrateSession.TryPrepareLocalForMigrationOverride = () => true;
            migrateSession.BumpAndWaitForEpochTransitionAsyncOverride = () => Task.FromResult(true);
            migrateSession.ReserveDestinationVectorSetsAsyncOverride = () => Task.FromResult(false);
            migrateSession.TryRecoverFromFailureAsyncOverride = () => Task.CompletedTask;

            await migrateSession.CallBeginAsyncMigrationTaskAsync();

            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Failed to reserve destination vector sets")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task BeginAsyncMigrationTaskAsync_LogsError_WhenMigrateSlotsDriverInlineFails()
        {
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var migrateSession = new TestMigrateSession(loggerMock.Object);

            migrateSession.TrySetSlotRangesAsyncOverride = (nodeid, state) => Task.FromResult(true);
            migrateSession.TryPrepareLocalForMigrationOverride = () => true;
            migrateSession.BumpAndWaitForEpochTransitionAsyncOverride = () => Task.FromResult(true);
            migrateSession.ReserveDestinationVectorSetsAsyncOverride = () => Task.FromResult(true);
            migrateSession.MigrateSlotsDriverInlineAsyncOverride = () => Task.FromResult(false);
            migrateSession.TryRecoverFromFailureAsyncOverride = () => Task.CompletedTask;

            await migrateSession.CallBeginAsyncMigrationTaskAsync();

            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("MigrateSlotsDriver failed")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}

using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.cluster
{
    public class MigrateSessionTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task TryStartMigrationTaskAsync_ReturnsSuccess_ForKeysTransferOption()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var migrateSessionType = typeof(MigrateSession);
            var instance = System.Runtime.Serialization.FormatterServices.GetUninitializedObject(migrateSessionType);

            // Set transferOption to KEYS (enum TransferOption is internal, so use reflection)
            var transferOptionField = migrateSessionType.GetField("transferOption", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            var transferOptionType = transferOptionField.FieldType;
            var keysValue = System.Enum.Parse(transferOptionType, "KEYS");
            transferOptionField.SetValue(instance, keysValue);

            // Set logger field
            var loggerField = migrateSessionType.GetField("logger", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            loggerField.SetValue(instance, loggerMock.Object);

            // Act
            var method = migrateSessionType.GetMethod("TryStartMigrationTaskAsync");
            var task = (ValueTask<(bool Success, System.ReadOnlyMemory<byte> ErrorMessage)>)method.Invoke(instance, null);
            var result = await task;

            // Assert
            Assert.True(result.Success);
        }
    }
}
